status: Design specification - not an executable engine

stages.title: Authorise and define boundaries
stages.outputs: Project charter; role and authority matrix; information-handling plan

tasks.title: Confirm mission and project boundary
tasks.action: Record business outcome, site alias, new build / retrofit / expansion, exclusions and interfaces.

tasks.title: Appoint accountable people
tasks.action: Name sponsor, PM, design leads, operations owner, security authority, commissioning lead and change authority; record deputies.

tasks.title: Agree information handling
tasks.action: Approve repositories, classification labels, photographs, devices, exports, retention and offline working; no restricted site data in this template repository.

tasks.title: Establish project mandate
tasks.action: Record funding envelope, decision rights, contract authority and permission for surveys; distinguish survey authority from installation authority.

tasks.title: Create control records
tasks.action: Assign project ID and initialise requirements, risks, decisions, evidence and document revision registers.

stages.title: Define requirements and criticality
stages.outputs: Owner requirements; acceptance strategy; standards applicability register

tasks.title: Define service requirements
tasks.action: List supported services, operating hours, planned maintenance windows, outage consequences, recovery time and data-loss objectives.

tasks.title: Define capacity and growth
tasks.action: Record initial and forecast racks, IT load, connectivity, storage and expansion assumptions with units and confidence.

tasks.title: Define security outcomes
tasks.action: Record threat assessment owner, protection objectives, zones, access roles, evidence restrictions and required client accreditation decisions.

tasks.title: Agree acceptance before design
tasks.action: Give each requirement a measurable criterion, verification method, witness, owner and acceptance authority.

tasks.title: Select applicable obligations
tasks.action: Identify jurisdiction, client standards, contract clauses, current adopted editions and specialist verification owners; unresolved applicability blocks affected design release.

tasks.title: Approve commissioning scope
tasks.action: Include power, cooling, controls, security, fire/life safety interfaces, cabling, network and operational readiness as applicable.

stages.title: Survey and assess feasibility
stages.outputs: Survey report; baseline inventory; dependency map; option assessment

tasks.title: Review existing records
tasks.action: Compare authorised drawings and inventory with observations; mark known, inferred and unverified facts separately.

tasks.title: Survey site and delivery routes
tasks.action: Assess space, floor/loading evidence, rack delivery route, pathways, penetrations and access constraints with competent specialists.

tasks.title: Map facilities interfaces
tasks.action: Obtain verified power capacity and source mapping, cooling capacity, environmental monitoring, fire protection and bonding responsibilities.

tasks.title: Trace service dependencies
tasks.action: Map current network, storage, management and A/B dependencies without disconnecting services; escalate unverified paths.

tasks.title: Compare feasible options
tasks.action: Assess reuse, upgrade, new build and permitted external provision against requirements, risk, lifecycle cost and schedule.

tasks.title: Resolve feasibility blockers
tasks.action: Record unacceptable constraints and required investigations; sponsor chooses proceed, revise or cancel.

stages.title: Develop and baseline design
stages.outputs: Basis of design; coordinated drawings; specifications; test criteria
stages.approvers: Design authority; owner; operations; security; commissioning lead

tasks.title: Approve concept design
tasks.action: Compare options against owner requirements; approve chosen concept and documented residual risks.

tasks.title: Coordinate detailed design
tasks.action: Coordinate structural, electrical, cooling, fire, security, controls and ICT interfaces; verify maintainability and delivery access.

tasks.title: Design complete cabling paths
tasks.action: Specify endpoints, optics, leads, panels, cassettes, trunk strands, polarity, routes, labels and approved test limits.

tasks.title: Review common failure modes
tasks.action: Review shared upstream power, shared routes, controls, carriers and maintenance dependencies; two labels do not prove independence.

tasks.title: Review operations and testability
tasks.action: Commissioning lead checks witness points, isolation boundaries, restoration, test loads and acceptance evidence.

tasks.title: Release controlled construction package
tasks.action: Resolve comments; baseline drawings, bill of materials, requirements and specifications; formally record owner approval.

stages.title: Plan delivery and procure
stages.outputs: WBS; dependency schedule; cost baseline; contract and submittal records

tasks.title: Build work packages
tasks.action: Split work by room, system and deliverable; assign owner, prerequisites, effort, resources and acceptance evidence.

tasks.title: Baseline schedule and budget
tasks.action: Include client actions, clearances, long lead items, testing, rework, contingencies and handover; obtain approval.

tasks.title: Select qualified suppliers
tasks.action: Evaluate competence, scope compliance, security obligations, supportability and commercial terms; document selection.

tasks.title: Approve submittals and substitutions
tasks.action: Match products and shop drawings to the baseline; changes require impact assessment before order or installation.

tasks.title: Authorise orders and logistics
tasks.action: Record purchase authority, quantities, delivery dates, secure storage, receipt inspection and defective-item quarantine.

tasks.title: Prepare quality and communications plans
tasks.action: Define inspections, hold points, reporting cadence, escalation, RFI process and document distribution.

stages.title: Release work for installation
stages.owner: Site lead; operations; safety and security leads
stages.outputs: Work authorisation; method statement; permits; readiness checklist
stages.approvers: Site authority; operations; relevant safety/security authorities

tasks.title: Confirm construction authority
tasks.action: Obtain notice to proceed or equivalent for this scope; verify current drawings and approved material submittals.

tasks.title: Confirm people and access
tasks.action: Check competence, induction, clearance, escort, tools, permitted devices and supervision.

tasks.title: Accept prerequisite facilities
tasks.action: Obtain relevant trade releases, room readiness, supports, environmental conditions and safe access evidence.

tasks.title: Inspect and receive materials
tasks.action: Check identity, quantity, condition, serials and custody; quarantine discrepancies and update procurement records.

tasks.title: Approve method and rollback
tasks.action: Identify exact assets, steps, impact, stop conditions, safe state, recovery actions, latest rollback time and contacts.

tasks.title: Release individual work packages
tasks.action: Confirm permits and change window still valid, dependencies complete and control-room coordination; otherwise hold.

stages.title: Install and record
stages.outputs: Installation inspections; daily log; redlines; asset and connection records

tasks.title: Install infrastructure in dependency order
tasks.action: Release supports and pathways before cabling; verify specialist works and concealed-work inspections before covering.

tasks.title: Rack and stack
tasks.action: Check approved elevation, rails, fixings, loading and lifting method against manufacturer instructions; preserve airflow and access.

tasks.title: Install and identify cable plant
tasks.action: Install approved routes, protection and terminations; record cable IDs, strand mapping, both ends and measured lengths.

tasks.title: Connect only authorised services
tasks.action: Verify exact endpoints and applicable change authority before patching or energisation; electrical work remains with authorised specialists.

tasks.title: Inspect and update as-built records
tasks.action: Record actual positions, routes, power feeds and deviations as work progresses; do not defer reconstruction to closeout.

tasks.title: Record defects and daily progress
tasks.action: Log quantities, labour, delays, safety/security issues and next work; correct through approved methods and re-inspect.

stages.title: Verify components and subsystems
stages.outputs: Pre-functional records; component and link tests; defect retests

tasks.title: Confirm test readiness
tasks.action: Check approved script revision, isolated boundaries, witnesses, calibration and instrument suitability.

tasks.title: Inspect before functional testing
tasks.action: Verify installation condition, identification, configuration baseline, cleanliness and required specialist certificates.

tasks.title: Test cabling to agreed specification
tasks.action: Record link identity, method, wavelengths where applicable, reference setup, measured values, limits and raw evidence; link-up alone is insufficient.

tasks.title: Test each subsystem
tasks.action: Execute approved power, cooling, monitoring, network and security tests by authorised teams; record expected and actual response.

tasks.title: Resolve failures and retest
tasks.action: Create defect, preserve failed results, correct through change control and record new test attempt with affected regression scope.

tasks.title: Complete agreed observation period
tasks.action: Use project-approved duration and load profile; reset or extend affected observation after material changes as agreed.

stages.title: Prove integrated and operational readiness
stages.outputs: Integrated tests; recovery evidence; training and readiness records

tasks.title: Approve integrated test scenarios
tasks.action: Map each scenario to requirements, predicted impact, recovery method, witnesses and explicit stop criteria.

tasks.title: Verify resilience end to end
tasks.action: Run only authorised scenarios demonstrating service response across power, cooling, network, controls and monitoring dependencies.

tasks.title: Verify security and emergency interfaces
tasks.action: Authorised specialists test access/alarm and life-safety interactions against approved cause-and-effect criteria.

tasks.title: Demonstrate recovery and restoration
tasks.action: Verify backups/configurations, recovery roles, restoration and approved RTO/RPO evidence where in scope.

tasks.title: Train operations and exercise procedures
tasks.action: Record attendance and demonstrated competence in normal, maintenance and emergency procedures.

tasks.title: Review readiness and residual defects
tasks.action: Unresolved critical defects block service release; any permitted minor deferral needs named owner, deadline and client acceptance.

stages.title: Cut over and accept service
stages.outputs: Cutover record; service acceptance; monitoring and rollback evidence

tasks.title: Reconfirm go or no-go
tasks.action: Verify current readiness, backup/recovery evidence, support staff, window, communications and rollback deadline.

tasks.title: Execute approved migration steps
tasks.action: Record actual times and observations for each step; stop on unexpected conditions or loss of control.

tasks.title: Validate user-facing services
tasks.action: Check application/service criteria with owners, alongside facilities/network health; infrastructure up is not service acceptance.

tasks.title: Rollback or stabilise
tasks.action: Apply the approved recovery decision if criteria fail or the latest rollback time is reached; verify restored service.

tasks.title: Obtain operational acceptance
tasks.action: Record service owner decision, accepted configuration, custody transfer and initial support arrangements.

stages.title: Handover and close
stages.outputs: Accepted handover pack; closeout record; obligations tracker

tasks.title: Reconcile deliverables
tasks.action: Reconcile requirements to accepted evidence, inventory to physical assets and cable schedules to test records.

tasks.title: Deliver controlled documentation
tasks.action: Provide approved as-builts, rack elevations, power maps, patching matrix, test reports, O&M, warranties and licences.

tasks.title: Close or transfer outstanding items
tasks.action: Obtain approval for residual minor items with owner/due date; keep warranty and future test obligations visible.

tasks.title: Transfer access and custody
tasks.action: Hand over spares, keys and authorised credentials through approved channels; remove temporary accounts and permissions.

tasks.title: Complete commercial closeout
tasks.action: Reconcile variations, invoices, retention and contract-specific completion criteria; completion does not erase surviving obligations.

tasks.title: Capture lessons and archive
tasks.action: Agree document custodian, retention and operational change process; record lessons and planned follow-up tests.
